linkedin.text:
🚨 Your AI coding agent just burned $47 rediscovering what a function does.

Then it forgot. Then it searched again. Then it read the same files. Then the context window filled up and it started hallucinating fixes.

Most agents waste 70-90% of their context budget on exploration work that could have been computed once.

repowise solves this by building a codebase intelligence layer your agent queries instead of grepping:

✅ Dependency graph across 16 languages with call resolution and framework-aware edges
✅ Git hotspots, ownership, co-change pairs, and defect history tied to every file
✅ Code health scoring on 25 deterministic markers with concrete refactoring plans

The result: up to 96% fewer tokens to load context, 89% fewer file reads, 70% fewer tool calls.

It runs locally, needs no API key for the first index, and your code never leaves your machine. One pip install, and your agent stops guessing.

The health layer is defect-validated and names the exact fix: Extract Class, Break Cycle, Split File, with blast radius and ranked impact. No LLM calls, under 30 seconds on a 3,000-file repo.

⭐ 1,200+ stars on GitHub

Search "repowise-dev/repowise" on GitHub and see how much context budget you're wasting right now.

Have you tried giving your agent structured codebase intelligence instead of raw grep output?
